title: A test: silicon ore of Stormward Silicon (Edasich) into storage at Cargo Lanes Freight Depot (eleven jumps, lawless)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 23:45 UTC (orders ENT-084, block ZERO: cut gathers of ore above its max; the freed hours test silicon and carbon fields, one ship first; rules F3, F23, F24, F37). Stormward Silicon read silicon 1,626 of 20,000 at richness 37 and nothing else (table fields, 1.4 h old at 23:37 UTC), lawless, eleven jumps from Cargo Lanes by Alrakis, GSC-0051, Segin, Nekkar, Silvermark, Upsilon Andromedae, Lalande 21185, Jabbah, GSC-0047 and Alsuhail; no pirate line on that road in 24 h; Crix Stronghold (pirates) stands four jumps from the field. Silicon is short 48,780 for the reserve and bid 386 to 539 cr a unit (tool market, 23:34 UTC). A Nebula Prospect (hold 100) flies it. One ship, hold empty, three results before a lift (F3, F37); stores everything, sells nothing (F24, P5); each run gives the reserve's ores of its hold and of the pilot's storage there to the station's hauler (gift).
